name: Hookfang Shanker's Corrosive Poison names its real per-tick damage instead of a constant zero (#7988)
contract: Spell 13526 (Corrosive Poison, Hookfang Shanker's chance-on-hit proc) is a periodic Nature damage aura (effect 0, EffectBasePoints 0 / EffectDieSides 1 / EffectRealPointsPerLevel 0.25, amplitude 3 sec) plus an armor-bypass aura (effect 1, base 2 = 3%); the aura itself computes and ticks the real per-level amount. Only the client's own Spell.dbc Description is wrong: it reads 'deals ${$abs(0)} Nature damage every 3 sec', a constant zero instead of the level-scaled '$s1' reference that every other periodic-damage tooltip uses for its own effect. coa_client_spell_description is baked into the client's spell rows, so the fix republishes 13526's own sentence with '$s1' in place of the dead '${$abs(0)}' term, leaving the rest (the 3 sec tick and the armor-bypass clause) untouched. This scenario reads the client row for 13526, with row 500639 (Runeshroud, published by the same table) as the control that the client rows are read. Expected before the SQL: the row carries '${$abs(0)}'. Expected after: it carries '$s1' instead, and still names the 3 sec tick and the armor-bypass clause.

steps.label: CONTROL: the client's spell row 500639 still carries Runeshroud's own text, so client rows are being read
CONTROL: this table really does publish a row for 13526, so the absence check below cannot pass vacuously
